description: What each construct the Ibis replay meets waits on: an issue, or the reason sverify refuses it by design. sverify_dev.ibis_replay reads it; a refusal that names an issue itself (#n) needs no entry.

constructs.match: cannot cast this value to a double
constructs.design: DuckDB has no cast between a timestamp and a number: CAST raises, TRY_CAST gives NULL, and Ibis reaches its values through epoch functions; cast through epoch_us

constructs.match: cannot cast this value to an integer
constructs.design: DuckDB has no cast between a timestamp and a number: CAST raises, TRY_CAST gives NULL, and Ibis reaches its values through epoch functions; cast through epoch_us

constructs.match: cannot cast this value to a timestamp
substring with a length that comes from a column
constructs.design: the length of a substring is a constant: a length read from a column is not modelled; use a constant length or ifelse over the cases
no engine gives one value for a quantile of a decimal (ruling 191); cast the column to float64 first
an approximation is each engine's own estimate; median() and quantile() are exact
an approximation is each engine's own estimate; median() and quantile() are exact
the row id is the engine's own
a positional join pairs rows by the engine's own order

constructs.match: typeof is only supported of a column
constructs.design: an expression's type is each engine's own inference (#508)
no engine sverify supports has a float16 type
a decimal's precision is part of its type; the refusal says to cast
the regular expressions all engines agree on are a documented subset (docs/reference-semantics.md)

constructs.match: LIMIT and OFFSET must be integers
casts of structs are not supported
constructs.design: sverify cannot build a struct value yet; cast its fields

constructs.match: avg of FLOAT (fp32) values is not modelled
